learnedRules.rule: Dynamic Profit Trailing: Ride winning trades beyond 1:2 R:R toward ₹4,000–₹5,000+ using ratcheted trailing stops. Move SL to Break-Even at +1.2R (Zero Risk). Never cut a strong runner prematurely.
learnedRules.context: Trained by Raj: 'Agar AI 5000+ kama sakta hai to ham use kyun roken, use kamane denge bas jyada loss nahi lenge.'

learnedRules.rule: Daily Loss Circuit Breaker: If 2 consecutive stop losses are hit in a single day (-₹2,000 max drawdown), halt all new trades for the day. Protect capital at all costs.
learnedRules.context: Trained by Raj: 'Bas ham jyada loss nahi lenge, capital preservation first.'

learnedRules.rule: Quality Over Quantity: Limit trading to max 3-4 high-conviction trades per day. Only enter on confirmed 20 EMA pullbacks with RSI 45-65.
learnedRules.context: Trained by Raj: 'Overtrading se bacho, patient sniper trading karo.'

learnedRules.rule: Prime Institutional Liquidity Windows: Focus Gold & Crypto execution during London (1:30 PM - 5:30 PM IST) and New York (6:30 PM - 11:30 PM IST) session expansions.
learnedRules.context: Trained by Raj: 'Institutional volume time par hi clean ₹4,000–₹5,000 trend moves milte hain.'

learnedRules.rule: US CPI news release ke dauran Gold (XAUUSD) mein trading se bacho, kyunki high volatility aur unpredictable price movements ka risk rehta hai.
learnedRules.context: Directly coached by Raj: "Gold mein 8:30 PM US CPI news ke time trade mat lena"

learnedRules.rule: Never risk more than 1.0% of total account capital on any single trade (Jim Simons Rule).
learnedRules.context: Capital preservation is priority #1. Even 10 consecutive losses will preserve 90% capital.

learnedRules.rule: Maintain a minimum 1:2 Risk-to-Reward ratio on every execution (Mark Minervini Rule).
learnedRules.context: With a 1:2 R:R, even a 40% win rate generates substantial long-term profit.

learnedRules.rule: Avoid opening BUY positions when RSI > 68 or price is overextended far above 20 EMA.
learnedRules.context: Chasing extended green candles into resistance leads to high probability liquidity traps.

learnedRules.rule: Move Stop Loss to Break-Even (Cost) as soon as trade profit reaches +1.2R.
learnedRules.context: Secures a "free trade" and eliminates emotional exit anxiety.

learnedRules.rule: Do not take counter-trend trades against 20 EMA without a confirmed multi-timeframe divergence.
learnedRules.context: Trading against institutional momentum without divergence has a <30% historical edge.
